status: accepted requirement; UI exploration; end-to-end archive discovery not implemented
user_intent: Create musical soundscapes for selected species at selected historical dates/times where genuine data is available.

selection.species: one or more species; namespaced IDs; optional individual/deployment where evidenced
selection.time: point or bounded observation-time interval with timezone; UTC stored internally
selection.sources: only permitted zero-charge archives, local recordings or authorised imports

required: show accessible interval and source resolution
distinguish missing records from animal inactivity
show requested versus actually available interval
never imply arbitrary historical dates are supported
never synthesize fake animal events to fill archive gaps
freeze selected event revisions and provenance
save query, timezone, source precision, coverage and gap metadata
choose observed-time versus arrival-time replay explicitly
preserve deterministic event ordering and seed
per-species voice design and region-specific effect routing
speed changes affect event spacing without implicitly shifting pitch

cost_policy: Zero paid services/data/dependencies. A paid or inaccessible archive remains unavailable; no billing fallback.

already_present: frozen sessions and portable local bundles
remaining: historical provider capabilities/discovery and permitted archive imports
